description: Contains unique identifiers for contracts (codes, numbers), descriptive titles, and the name/code of the project the contract is linked to.
Tracks the current lifecycle phase (e.g., 'Under Negotiation'), contract status and numerical percentages for both planned and actual work progress.
Comprehensive date fields for start, end, and signing. Supports filtering by Gregorian dates, Persian (Solar Hijri) dates, or specific Year/Month/Day components.
Detailed currency values including initial budget, final adjusted amounts, total addendum values, and cumulative payments or billing amounts.
Summary counts and dates for secondary events like the number of addendums (الحاقیه), frequency of payments, and the date of the most recent status report (صورت وضعیت).
Specific metadata from contract circulation forms such as guarantee types, workshop (site) names, and contractor-specific logistical information.
